sans.purpose: Platform-native body text and Chinese fallbacks without font downloads.

display.purpose: Time-aware greeting, scaled down across tablet and phone.

shadows.name: segmented-selection
shadows.purpose: Structural separation of the selected course scope.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The shared primary action uses its own accessible fill and foreground pair.
components.css: .ds-button-primary{min-height:44px;padding:9px 15px;border:1px solid var(--line-soft,#e5e5ea);border-radius:var(--desk-control-radius,11px);font:500 13px -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI Variable","Segoe UI","Microsoft YaHei UI","PingFang SC",sans-serif;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color .15s,color .15s}.ds-button-primary:disabled{opacity:.5;cursor:not-allowed}.ds-button-primary:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--blue,#007aff);outline-offset:3px}.ds-button-primary:active{transform:translateY(1px)}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-button-primary{transition:none}}.ds-button-primary{background:var(--action-fill,#0063cf);color:var(--action-ink,#ffffff);border-color:transparent}@media(hover:hover){.ds-button-primary:hover{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--action-fill,#0063cf),var(--ink,#1c1c1e) 15%)}}

components.name: Quiet Button
components.description: Secondary actions remain on a white surface with a subtle boundary.
components.css: .ds-button-quiet{min-height:44px;padding:9px 15px;border:1px solid var(--line-soft,#e5e5ea);border-radius:var(--desk-control-radius,11px);font:500 13px -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI Variable","Segoe UI","Microsoft YaHei UI","PingFang SC",sans-serif;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color .15s,color .15s}.ds-button-quiet:disabled{opacity:.5;cursor:not-allowed}.ds-button-quiet:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--blue,#007aff);outline-offset:3px}.ds-button-quiet:active{transform:translateY(1px)}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-button-quiet{transition:none}}.ds-button-quiet{background:var(--panel,#ffffff);color:var(--ink,#1c1c1e)}@media(hover:hover){.ds-button-quiet:hover{background:var(--soft,#eeeef3);border-color:var(--line,#c7c7cc)}}

components.name: Text Field
components.description: A labeled shared field; native control ownership and retained-input behavior stay in Forms.
components.html: <label class="ds-field-label" for="ds-course-name">课程名称</label><input class="ds-field" id="ds-course-name" type="text" value="高等数学I1">
components.css: .ds-field-label{display:block;margin-bottom:7px;color:var(--ink,#1c1c1e);font:500 13px -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI Variable","Segoe UI","Microsoft YaHei UI","PingFang SC",sans-serif}.ds-field{display:block;max-width:100%;min-height:43px;padding:10px 12px;border:1px solid var(--line,#c7c7cc);border-radius:var(--desk-control-radius,11px);background:var(--panel,#ffffff);color:var(--ink,#1c1c1e);font:14px -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI Variable","Segoe UI","Microsoft YaHei UI","PingFang SC",sans-serif}.ds-field:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--blue,#007aff);outline-offset:3px}.ds-field:disabled{opacity:.5}@media(hover:hover){.ds-field:hover{border-color:var(--muted,#63636b)}}@media(max-width:639px){.ds-field{font-size:16px}}

components.name: Selected Navigation
components.description: Current-page navigation uses readable blue text and a quiet blue field.
components.css: .ds-navigation{width:184px}.ds-nav-item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;width:100%;min-height:46px;padding:11px 13px;border:0;border-radius:var(--desk-control-radius,11px);background:var(--blue-soft,#e5f0ff);color:var(--blue-text,#0063cf);font:600 14px -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI Variable","Segoe UI","Microsoft YaHei UI","PingFang SC",sans-serif;text-align:left;cursor:pointer}.ds-nav-item:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--blue,#007aff);outline-offset:3px}@media(hover:hover){.ds-nav-item:hover{background:var(--soft,#eeeef3);color:var(--ink,#1c1c1e)}}

components.name: Completion Status
components.description: Completion stays explicit in text as well as color.
components.css: .ds-status-complete{display:inline-block;padding:5px 9px;border-radius:7px;background:var(--green-soft,#edf8ef);color:var(--green-text,#217a38);font:12px -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI Variable","Segoe UI","Microsoft YaHei UI","PingFang SC",sans-serif}

components.name: Study Group
components.description: The quiet white reading container used by Today.
components.html:
今日课程

今天没有排课，按自己的节奏学习。
components.css: .ds-study-group{max-width:420px;padding:20px 22px;border:0;border-radius:var(--desk-radius,18px);background:var(--panel,#ffffff);color:var(--ink,#1c1c1e);font:14px -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI Variable","Segoe UI","Microsoft YaHei UI","PingFang SC",sans-serif}.ds-group-heading{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:10px;min-height:30px;margin-bottom:12px}.ds-group-heading h2{margin:0;font-size:17px;font-weight:650;line-height:1.5;letter-spacing:-.3px}.ds-group-link{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;min-height:44px;border:0;background:none;color:var(--blue-text,#0063cf);font:12px -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI Variable","Segoe UI","Microsoft YaHei UI","PingFang SC",sans-serif;cursor:pointer}.ds-group-note{margin:12px 0;color:var(--muted,#63636b);font-size:13px;line-height:1.8}.ds-group-link:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--blue,#007aff);outline-offset:3px}@media(hover:hover){.ds-group-link:hover{text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:3px}}

components.name: Task Row
components.description: Native checkbox semantics inside a 44px target; completion and restore reuse the existing task owner.
components.css: .ds-task-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;min-height:52px;color:var(--ink,#1c1c1e);font:14px -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI Variable","Segoe UI","Microsoft YaHei UI","PingFang SC",sans-serif}.ds-task-target{position:relative;display:grid;place-items:center;width:44px;height:44px;flex:0 0 44px;cursor:pointer}.ds-task-target input{position:absolute;width:22px;height:22px;margin:0;opacity:0}.ds-task-circle{display:grid;place-items:center;width:21px;height:21px;border:1.5px solid var(--line,#c7c7cc);border-radius:50%;background:var(--panel,#ffffff)}.ds-task-circle svg{visibility:hidden}.ds-task-target input:checked+.ds-task-circle{background:var(--green,#34c759);border-color:var(--green,#34c759);color:#11351b}.ds-task-target input:checked+.ds-task-circle svg{visibility:visible}.ds-task-target input:focus-visible+.ds-task-circle{outline:3px solid var(--blue,#007aff);outline-offset:4px}.ds-task-label{position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;overflow:hidden;clip-path:inset(50%)}.ds-task-title{min-height:44px;border:0;background:none;padding:10px 0;color:var(--ink,#1c1c1e);font:inherit;cursor:pointer;text-align:left}.ds-task-title:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--blue,#007aff);outline-offset:3px}@media(hover:hover){.ds-task-title:hover{color:var(--blue-text,#0063cf)}}@media(forced-colors:active){.ds-task-circle{border-color:ButtonText}.ds-task-target input:checked+.ds-task-circle{background:Highlight;color:HighlightText}}

components.name: Course Scope Control
components.description: Native pressed buttons switch the Today course subset without changing course facts.
components.css: .ds-segmented{display:inline-flex;padding:3px;gap:2px;border-radius:9px;background:var(--soft,#eeeef3)}.ds-segment{min-width:48px;min-height:30px;padding:5px 10px;border:0;border-radius:7px;background:transparent;color:var(--muted,#63636b);font:12px -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI Variable","Segoe UI","Microsoft YaHei UI","PingFang SC",sans-serif;cursor:pointer}.ds-segment[aria-pressed="true"]{background:var(--panel,#ffffff);color:var(--ink,#1c1c1e);box-shadow:0 1px 3px #0000000d}.ds-segment:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--blue,#007aff);outline-offset:3px}@media(hover:hover){.ds-segment:hover{color:var(--ink,#1c1c1e)}}@media(pointer:coarse){.ds-segment{min-height:44px}}

narrative.overview:
A calm personal university study workspace, with the clarity of an Apple HIG-inspired tool and the familiar controls of the device in use. Restrained gray, white and blue keep coursework readable; coherent subject covers give courses a recognizable identity. The interface uses a real web application shell with platform-aware navigation, keyboard and touch behavior. Reference images and the generated concept set direction; they are not pixel-copy specifications or sources of product facts.

The owner's November 3, 2026 redesign authorization supersedes earlier task-scoped prohibitions on new colors, imagery, navigation and dashboard composition. It preserves business, evidence and confirmation rules in UX-CONTRACT.md. The canonical runtime token owner is `src/personal/design-tokens.css`, imported by `src/personal/desk.css`; this document mirrors that source. Update the runtime and this mirror together. The shared system is being applied incrementally, as recorded below.
keyCharacteristics: Restrained neutral surfaces, sparse blue actions and explicit written states.
Local system typography and a coherent subject-cover signature.
Responsive navigation that supports mouse, keyboard and touch.
Existing interaction owners and real records throughout the redesign.

rules.name: The Separate Roles Rule
rules.body: Do not substitute the decorative accent for a text or primary-button token. In light mode the primary action uses Readable Blue with white; dark mode uses its own light-blue fill and dark foreground. The full light/dark values and scrollbar colors remain in the canonical runtime file.

rules.name: The Quiet Surface Rule
rules.body: Reading groups stay calm at rest. Use depth to identify an overlay or selected control, and keep ordinary content on tonal surfaces.

dos: **Do** update canonical runtime tokens and this mirror together.
**Do** use readable text and action pairs for their intended surfaces in light and dark appearance.
**Do** reuse the shared course artwork, task row, sheets, forms, read states and navigation guard.
**Do** preserve real course identity, immutable evidence and the existing confirmation boundary.
**Do** keep keyboard focus visible, touch targets usable and reduced-motion behavior intact.
**Do** report the migration scope and real-device verification limits accurately.
donts: **Don't** turn a reference image or generated concept into product facts, rooms, schedules or progress.
**Don't** choose course imagery by record ID or treat decorative artwork as evidence.
**Don't** add task deletion, weather, remote fonts or new confirmation owners through this visual change.
**Don't** claim that token inheritance completes the redesign of a deeper screen.
**Don't** claim physical-device installation, safe-area acceptance or public deployment from browser tests.
